name: A tab frozen by the browser through the renewal: after waking up it uses the token the other tab renewed
description: The second tab is frozen the way Chrome freezes background tabs: no timers, no code. The first tab renews alone. Once unfrozen, the second tab finds the renewed token in the storage and works on without a renewal of its own.
descriptionHtml:
The second tab is frozen the way Chrome freezes background tabs: no timers, no code. The first tab renews alone. Once unfrozen, the second tab finds the renewed token in the storage and works on without a renewal of its own.
